steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. Each set-up step is placed before the start date.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 registration is not complete before the start date

findings.title: Registration not complete before the start date
findings.fix: Complete the registration before the start

findings.title: Contract term not in the country checklist
findings.fix: Align the term to the country checklist

findings.title: Step with no source
findings.fix: Cite the source of the step
